findings.evidence: Each conclusion sums only `i : R` and `b : i ⟶ v`; the proof’s sole decomposition call is likewise for paths into `v`. Signless/Augmentation.lean:44 already assumes every `Quiver.Star x` is Fintype, while KoszulComplex.lean:159 demonstrates deriving hom-set Fintypes locally via `Fintype.ofFinite`.
findings.fix: Generalize the decomposition and quotient statements to finiteness only of incoming homs `∀ i, Fintype (i ⟶ v)`; in the signless specialization derive these locally from `[∀ x, Fintype (Quiver.Star x)]` instead of exposing an additional all-homs assumption.
findings.issue: `exists_eq_sum_ofArrow_mul_of_mem_arrowIdeal` unnecessarily assumes `∀ i j, Fintype (i ⟶ j)`; the same over-strong hypothesis propagates to the quotient theorems at Augmentation.lean:47,85 and the signless theorem at Signless/Augmentation.lean:96.

summary: The augmentation exactness API requires global hom-set Fintypes although only arrows into the selected vertex are summed, and the signless specialization already has enough star finiteness to derive those locally.
